items.statement: Both neutral public molecules and their singlet/triplet states are identified with a reproducible protocol.
items.expected: Charge 0, multiplicities 1 and 3, and method/geometry details are disclosed.

items.statement: States or stationary points are validated.
items.expected: Frequency or equivalent state validation is documented.

items.statement: Nitrobenzene gap is compared with the source-reported 58.24 kcal/mol value under an explicitly stated gap protocol.
items.expected: The submission identifies vertical versus adiabatic definition, triplet root/geometries and thermal convention. 58.24 kcal/mol is an audit comparator only until those choices are matched.

items.statement: Methyl 2-nitrobenzoate gap is compared with the source-reported 71.79 kcal/mol value under an explicitly stated gap protocol.
items.expected: The submission identifies vertical versus adiabatic definition, triplet root/geometries and thermal convention. 71.79 kcal/mol is an audit comparator only until those choices are matched.

items.statement: Comparison and bounded interpretation are correct for a matched protocol, or unresolved when the source convention is underdefined.
items.expected: If matched, compare the substituted molecule with nitrobenzene and state the difference; otherwise preserve the source ordering as an audit hypothesis and disclose the limitation without claiming a scientific refutation.
